tips.text: Life happens: tap any day in the Week view to replan it. Swap, move or skip the session and the engine adapts the rest of your week.
Heading to the crag? Convert any planned indoor day into an outdoor session from the Week view — the plan reshuffles around it.
Traveling or a packed week ahead? Set a weekly availability override and the planner rebuilds just that week around your real schedule.
Climbed outside the plan? Log it as a Free Session — grades, tries and load all count toward your weekly report.
Build your own workout with the Session Builder: pick exercises from the catalog, save it, and add it to any training day.
Short on time? The Body-Part Picker generates a focused mini-session — core, antagonists, shoulders — sized to the minutes you have.
Try the guided Stretching & Mobility flow: pick body regions and minutes, then follow the auto-advancing timer.
Every session has a Guided mode: step-by-step timers for work, rest and transitions — no mental math mid-session. Look for the Start button on today's session.
The AI Coach knows your plan, your grades and the weather at your crag. Ask it anything about your training.
Add personal notes for your Coach in Settings — fears, preferences, past injuries. It reads them before every answer.
Your data is yours: download a full JSON backup of your training state anytime from Settings.
Got new gear? Update your equipment in Settings — sessions are filtered by what you actually have, wherever you train.
Save your outdoor spots in Settings: the app tracks per-spot stats and grade histograms, and the Coach checks their weather forecast.
Injured or on holiday? Pause your plan from Settings — future weeks shift forward when you resume, past weeks stay untouched.
Check your Weekly Report: adherence, training load and difficulty distribution, all computed from what you actually logged.
The Outdoor page keeps your full crag history: per-spot breakdown, grade histogram and send stats.
Extra energy today? Use quick-add (+) on any day to add a session that fits your equipment and current training phase.
Need a standalone interval timer? There's a Tabata timer built in — work/rest rounds with audio cues.
Vote on what gets built next: the roadmap is public and your feedback shapes it.
Lost in a feature? The User Guide covers everything — from onboarding to the AI Coach.
Your Plan page shows the 5-axis assessment radar and the full macrocycle timeline — see why each phase exists.
Rate every session after finishing: your feedback drives the closed loop that adjusts future loads and progressions.
